newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-PLAYER TURNED CHAT-SHOW HOST FACING $50,000 A MATCH FINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PLAYER TURNED CHAT-SHOW HOST FACING $50,000 A MATCH FINE.

text.p: Turkish soccer club Canakkale Dardanel, who dropped South African Steve Kompela from the first team last week for hosting a TV chat-show, are to impose a heavy fine for each match he misses.
Club secretary Ismet Guneshan accused Kompela of "treachery" saying that since he started hosting his own chat show the South African had not turned up for matches or training.
Kompela would be fined $50,000 for every match he missed, Guneshan said.
Kompela, 29, who was transferred from Gaziantepspor at the beginning of the season, has picked up enough rudimentary Turkish to interview guests and even sings the occasional song on his show.
"When we bought Kompela, we got a work permit for him to play football. He has now run away from Canakkale against our wishes," Guneshan said.
Struggling Canakkale are currently fourth from the bottom in the Turkish first division.
